evidence.note: The Fragmentation 3 values region and avoid-region force or avoid a break between CSS Regions. CSS Regions has no implementation in the current Chrome, Firefox or Safari (Blink removed it in 2014; BCD css.properties.flow-into has no support in any of them), so every browser parses these values and none acts on them. BCD has no entry of their own, so css-compat.json gave them the support of the property.
